npcs.name: Ottar Woodcutter
npcs.idle: I cut trees. That's all. That's all I ever did.

npcs.name: Sunniva
npcs.idle: (She opens her mouth, and nothing comes out. Tears roll down her face, silently, and she points west.)

npcs.name: Asgerd
npcs.idle: My husband hasn't slept a night through since winter. Something rides him.

npcs.name: Grimkel the Sleepless
npcs.idle: Hoofbeats. Every night. On my chest.

npcs.name: Woodward Brand
npcs.idle: New to Myrkwood? Stay near the town till you can hold an axe. Then stay near the town anyway.

npcs.name: Woodward-Captain Thora
npcs.idle: The Woodwards keep the roads open. Lately, the roads keep closing.

npcs.name: Volva Groa
npcs.idle: Sit, if you like. Everyone comes to the volva in the end. Wolves and priests too.

npcs.name: Woodward Kalf
npcs.idle: Gna Faste was a watch-tower once. Now it's where we watch the south.

quests.title: The Willow's Voice
quests.offer:
I felled a willow in the western wood this spring. A big old weeper. The next morning my daughter Sunniva woke and couldn't speak. She cries all day - no sound, just tears.

The seeress says the willows took her voice in payment. I'd give them anything. I'd give them my axe. Will you [help her]? Talk to her if you like. She can't answer.
quests.summary: Ottar felled an old willow, and the next morning his daughter woke unable to speak, only weep.

steps.goal: Talk to Sunniva
steps.say: (She takes your hand and presses something into it: a willow leaf, still green. Then she points west, toward the weeping grove, and shakes her head hard, and points again.)

steps.goal: Go to the weeping willow grove in the west
steps.text: The willows weep sap like rain. Under the sound of it, very faintly, a little girl's voice humming.

steps.goal: Fight through the weeping willows
steps.text: Each one that falls stops humming. The humming moves deeper in.

steps.goal: Find the stump of the willow Ottar felled
steps.text: Ottar's axe-marks, clean and deep. The sap has run down the stump and set in shapes like letters: GIVE BACK WHAT WAS TAKEN.

steps.goal: Face the Elder Willow
steps.text: The Elder Willow bows, groaning, to the ground. In the hollow of its trunk lies a little knot of heartwood that sings in a child's voice.

stages.name: the Elder Willow
stages.announce: The biggest willow in the grove opens eyes of knotted bark. 'THE AXE-MAN TOOK OUR SISTER. WE TOOK HIS DAUGHTER'S SONG.'

steps.goal: Bring the singing heartwood to Ottar
steps.say:
That's - that's her voice. In the wood. Gods.

The seeress says I can [plant the heartwood] at the stump, and swear never to fell a tree again, and the voice comes home. I'd have to find other work. I'm forty. I've only ever cut trees.

Or I [burn it] in the hearth, and the voice comes home tonight, and the willows remember us forever.

options.say: Then I'll plant it. And swear. And learn to - I don't know. Keep bees. Sunniva always wanted bees.
Burn it. Tonight. I want to hear her laugh tonight, not next spring. Let the trees remember.

planted.text: She sang this morning. Take this - she wants you to.

burned.text: She talks now. Doesn't stop. The willows by the house have started to lean toward it. Take this.

quests.title: Hoofbeats in the Night
quests.offer:
My Grimkel hasn't slept a night since winter. Something rides him - a mora, the old women say. A night-mare. It sits on his chest and he can't breathe, can't wake. He's wasting.

The moras dance in the southern wood, by the old shrine. Will you [stop it]? Ask [Grimkel] what he sees, if he's awake enough to tell you.

topics.Grimkel: He's by the hall. Sitting up. He won't lie down any more.

quests.summary: Something rides Asgerd's husband every night - a mora, a night-mare - and he is wasting away.

steps.goal: Ask Grimkel what he sees
steps.say: A woman. Pale. Riding a black horse that's also her. Every night, on my chest, galloping. She says I'm hers. She has a [bridle] of hair - my hair. She cut it while I slept.

steps.goal: Go to the moras' dancing grounds in the south
steps.text: Women dance in a ring, too light on their feet - and some of them have hooves.

steps.goal: Break the mora dance
steps.text: They dissolve into black mist. The ring breaks open. Riders on black horses circle further in.

steps.goal: Search the centre of the ring
steps.text: A bridle of braided hair - several bridles. Each a different colour. One is grey-brown, like Grimkel's.

steps.goal: Defeat the Mare-Queen
steps.text: The Mare-Queen's horse-half crumbles into ash, then her woman-half. Every bridle in the ring goes limp.

stages.name: the Mare-Queen
stages.announce: A rider on a horse that is also herself gallops out of the dark. 'Give me back my reins!'

steps.goal: Bring the bridle back to Asgerd
steps.say:
Is that his? His hair, in a bridle?

The old women say whoever holds the bridle can ride the mora's dreams - into anyone's sleep. Grimkel wants it. He wants to ride into the dreams of the man who cheated him at the spring fair. He's never been like this.

[Burn it]. Please. Or [give it to him], if you think he's earned his revenge. I can't stop him.

options.say: Thank you. Oh, thank you. ...Listen. He's snoring. He's SNORING.
...So be it. He's sleeping now. Smiling. I don't like the smile.

burned.text: Take this. We'll both sleep tonight.

quests.title: Frogs in the Well
quests.offer:
Welcome to the darkest corner of Midgard. You'll want to start small. The giant bull frogs from the marsh get into the town's well-stream and foul it.

Will you [chase off the frogs]? Stay close to town - nowhere else in Myrkwood is safe for you yet.
quests.summary: Giant bull frogs foul Galplen's well-stream. A first task for a new arrival.

steps.goal: Chase off the giant bull frogs near Galplen about 100 m north-east of Woodward Brand
Tell Woodward Brand
steps.say: Good. You're still alive. That's the first lesson of Myrkwood.

quests.title: Eyes in the Dark
quests.offer:
Myrkcats stalk the town's edge at night - you see their eyes in the dark, then you don't see your goats. Small ones, near the town. The big ones live deeper in. Don't go there.

Will you [hunt the myrkcats]?
quests.summary: Myrkcats stalk Galplen's edge at night and take the goats.

steps.goal: Hunt the myrkcats near Galplen about 140 m north-west of Woodward Brand
Tell Woodward Brand
steps.say: Goats are safe. You're learning. The Captain has something for you.

quests.title: Carrion on the Road
quests.offer:
Carrion eaters gather on the east road, where travellers die. They've learned to wait for the next one. Teach them otherwise and you've earned a place at our fire.

Will you [clear the road]? Then come back - I'll tell you what Myrkwood's really about.
quests.summary: Carrion eaters wait on Galplen's east road for the next traveller to die.

steps.goal: Drive off the carrion eaters about 190 m south-east of Woodward-Captain Thora
Tell Woodward-Captain Thora
steps.say:
That'll do. Welcome to Myrkwood.

Here's what it's about: there's an old volva in the willow-wood west of town, Groa. Wolves and priests both want her. When you're strong enough, she's who we protect.

quests.title: The Willow Road
quests.offer:
The road to the volva's hut runs through the willow-wood, and the haunts walk it. Groa sends for supplies and nobody will carry them.

Will you [clear the road]?
quests.summary: Haunts walk the willow-wood road between Galplen and the volva's hut.

steps.goal: Clear the haunts from the willow road about 290 m west of Woodward-Captain Thora
Carry the supplies to the volva's hut
steps.text: A hut of turf and willow, smoke curling from the roof. An old woman watches you from the door as if she knew you were coming.

steps.goal: Speak with Volva Groa
steps.say:
There you are. You took longer than I saw. Sit down.

You'll want to know why everyone's hunting an old woman. Bring me something first, and I'll tell you.

quests.title: Willow-Heart
quests.offer:
The weeping willows grow toward my hut a little every year. They want what I know, like everyone. Cut me a willow-heart - the wood at the centre - and I'll burn it, and they'll remember their place.

Will you [cut a willow-heart]?
quests.summary: The weeping willows of Myrkwood grow toward the volva's hut.

steps.goal: Fell the weeping willows about 150 m south-east of Volva Groa
Bring the willow-heart to Volva Groa
steps.say:
Good. Now listen.

I see how things end. The wolves want me because I see how Hati ends - the wolf that hunts the moon, Fenrir's son, in Raumarik. The priests want me because I know the rest of the dragon's name. Gjalpinulva. Her true name, the one that wakes her. They have half.

quests.title: Tinglers in the Hollows
quests.offer:
The tinglers in the western hollows feed on fear. There's a lot of fear in Myrkwood now, and they've grown fat on it. They come to my door at night.

Will you [hunt them]?
quests.summary: Tinglers in Myrkwood's western hollows have grown fat on the forest's fear.

steps.goal: Hunt the tinglers about 300 m south-west of Volva Groa
Tell Volva Groa
steps.say: Fewer. Fear's the coin of the times, I'm afraid. Wolves and dragons both deal in it.

quests.title: The Barrow-Dead
quests.offer:
The decaying norsemen have come out of the barrows south of Gna Faste. The dead don't walk in Myrkwood without a reason. Something's waking them.

Will you [put them down]?
quests.summary: Decaying norsemen have come out of the barrows south of Gna Faste.

steps.goal: Put down the decaying norsemen about 200 m south-east of Woodward Kalf
Tell Woodward Kalf
steps.say: Down. But they keep coming. The barrows are warm, Kalf says - me, I mean. I'm Kalf. They're warm.

quests.title: Warm Barrows
quests.offer:
The myrk shadows guard the barrows - and the barrows are warm. Get past them and look inside one. I want to know why the ground's warm.

Will you [look inside]?
quests.summary: Myrk shadows guard Myrkwood's barrows, and the barrows are warm.

steps.goal: Get past the myrk shadows about 350 m south-east of Woodward Kalf
Search inside a barrow

clue.name: a burial chamber, its stones scorched

steps.text: The dead man's hoard is gone, and the walls are scorched in long claw-marks. Drakelings, digging for gold. The svartalf in the south pay the drakulv in grave-gold.

steps.goal: Tell Kalf
steps.say: Grave-robbing drakelings, digging gold for the cult. And the dead wake angry. The missionaries camp in the south-east - Captain Thora will want to hear.

quests.title: The Worg Run
quests.offer:
The worgs in the middle wood run with the werewolves now. They scout for them - every pack we see, there's a werewolf a mile behind.

Will you [break the packs]?
quests.summary: Gray worgs in Myrkwood's middle wood scout for the werewolves of the west wood.

steps.goal: Break the gray worg packs about 510 m south-west of Woodward-Captain Thora
Tell Captain Thora
steps.say: Broken. Now they're blind. Groa says they're coming for her soon - before the next full moon.

quests.title: Fenrir's Kin
quests.offer:
The werewolves of the west wood call themselves Fenrir's kin. They answer to Hati, in Raumarik, and Hati wants to know how he ends - so he can change it.

Bring friends. Will you [hunt the werewolves]?
quests.summary: The werewolves of Myrkwood's west wood, Fenrir's kin, hunt the volva for Hati in Raumarik.

steps.goal: Hunt the werewolves of the west wood about 580 m south-west of Volva Groa
Bring down the werewolf nobles
Search the werewolf den
steps.text: A wolf's shoulder-blade carved with the moon in every phase, and the last one gnawed away. Scratched under it: 'THE SEER SAYS HOW HATI ENDS. TAKE HER TO RAUMARIK BEFORE THE WINTER.'

steps.goal: Tell Volva Groa
steps.say: Raumarik, before the winter. And Hati asks me how he ends. Well. I'll tell you instead, when the time comes - you'll be the one there.

quests.title: The Night-Riders
quests.offer:
The mora dance in the south now - not just riding men's dreams but dancing in the open, with dark hounds round them. They're stirred up.

Will you [break the dance]?
quests.summary: The mora dance openly in Myrkwood's south, with dark hounds round them.

steps.goal: Break the mora dancers about 760 m south of Asgerd
Kill the dark hounds
Tell Asgerd
steps.say: Quiet. I slept last night - first time in a month. Thank you.

quests.title: The Watchers
quests.offer:
Svartalf watchers in the south, between Gna Faste and the missionaries' camp. They watch the volva's road, and they report to the camp.

Will you [blind the watchers]?
quests.summary: Svartalf watchers in Myrkwood's south watch the volva's road for the drakulv missionaries.

steps.goal: Blind the svartalf watchers about 540 m south-east of Woodward Kalf
Tell Woodward Kalf
steps.say: Blind. Now they'll have to come in person. Good - I'd rather see them coming.

quests.title: The Missionaries' Orders
quests.offer:
The missionaries' camp in the south-east. A Wyrm-Deacon leads them, with svartalf predators for his hunters. Break the predators and get me their orders.

Bring friends. Will you [take the orders]?
quests.summary: Gjalpinulva's missionaries camp in Myrkwood's south-east, with svartalf predators for hunters.

steps.goal: Break the svartalf predators about 750 m south of Woodward-Captain Thora
Search the edge of the missionaries' camp

clue.name: a scroll-case marked with a dragon's eye

steps.text: Orders, in the Hierophant's hand: 'Bring the volva to Malmohus alive. With her half of the name and ours, the Mother wakes. Let the wolves have the north; we shall have everything.'

steps.goal: Tell Woodward-Captain Thora
steps.say:
The Hierophant, in Malmohus. They mean to wake Gjalpinulva with Groa's half of the name - and the wolves mean to drag her to Hati.

We hold Galplen, and we keep Groa. Everything past Myrkwood - Raumarik, Malmohus - is a war for the King's huscarls. But it starts here.
